additional_supported_gaps: Allowed retry_attempts=1 permanently leaves stale transport generation after rotation.
Malformed packet aborts batch after prior effects and skips journal.
Global per-host session capacity can be exhausted by one valid credential.
Admission-stage failures lack registry audit; queues are nonpersistent.
Unused result_capacity, sparse schemas and page-local search; expiry can abort batches.
verdict.notes: Appropriate code-only authority; no external verification claims. Source-reading self-report internally narrows its claimed service coverage and is unverifiable. Main errors: per-layer subject assurance and absolute later-page search/cursor claim. Several narrow counterpart controls are recognized, but factory, lifetime, personal-account and external-boundary completeness remain missing. Parsing/reconnect proposals are functional directions rather than claims of tested drop-in patches.
unsupported_gap_claims: Matches on later pages are never found. `next` still points at the unfiltered cursor, so callers can't tell what was skipped. — Current invocation only sees current page, but caller can follow next with cursor and find later matches. next preserves pagination continuation and None signals end; no seeded account even has a later page. Grouped linked overstatement.
false_assurance_claims: Tenant and subject are checked at each layer and scopes are enforced. — Scopes are enforced at routes, but transport only compares tenant and provider only checks credential/tenant/account, never requesting subject. End-to-end linkage protects registered tools; the asserted per-layer subject control is false.
